explanation: The Sorel article reads the 1609 fight as what put Champlain and the Mohawk on opposite sides for good: "The first deliberate battle in 1609 was fought at Champlain's initiative. Champlain deliberately went along with a war party down Lake Champlain. Furthermore, this battle created 150 years of mistrust that poisoned any chances that French-Iroquois alliances would be durable and long lived." The second battle is the first one continued a year later, with the same alliance and the same arquebuses. Wikipedia is the only author named, so probable.
